video.title: AI欧腐《血契予你/Bloodbound to You》
video.desc:
Sonny, heir of the Hunter family, accidentally awakens Victor, the Blood Lord imprisoned for three hundred years, during the sacred mountain sealing ritual. As family betrayal, past-life memories, and the "Holy Blood" conspiracy are unveiled one by one, the two men—who were destined to be mortal enemies—fall in love once more and join forces to overthrow the three-hundred-year-old hunting order.
猎人家族继承人Sonny在圣山封印仪式中，意外唤醒了被囚禁三百年的血族之主Victor。
随着家族背叛、前世记忆，以及“圣血”阴谋被一一揭开，这两个本该生死相敌的男人，却再次坠入爱河。
最终，他们选择联手，推翻延续了三百年的猎人秩序。
